review: Primary and independent agents manually inspected all ten images. The final browser run refreshed every capture; their byte hashes match the reviewed images.

sweep-desktop.png.observation: At 37 degrees C the outlined circle and guide align with the temperature peak. Fixed population ticks and inward endpoint labels are readable; the selected population is 99.7.

sweep-ph.png.observation: The pH samples use visibly unequal numeric spacing, with the selected pH 7 guide at the peak. Circles and flat-response squares remain distinct; all readouts are readable.

sweep-oxygen.png.observation: The selected 100/100 sample and guide remain visible at the right boundary. Uneven oxygen sample spacing follows the numeric axis, and the population readout is 98.3.

sweep-previous.png.observation: The previous sweep has its own selector. Its selected pH 5.5 guide and outlined point align with the 14.1 population readout; flat squares remain visible along the baseline.

sweep-phone-320.png.observation: At 320 pixels temperature labels fit on single lines. The focused selector has a clear outline, the selected point remains visible near the top, and numeric cards stack without overflow.

sweep-400-percent.png.observation: At 400 percent enlargement the figure, selector, legend and readout cards reflow vertically. Axis text remains aligned, marker shapes retain their proportions and focus is visible.

sweep-contrast.png.observation: The light forced-color canvas retains a blue dashed curve, dark guide and open selected ring. Circles and squares remain distinct, and text, cards and selector focus are clear.

sweep-ph-phone-320.png.observation: At 320 pixels the pH labels remain uncrowded. The selected 5.5 sample appears between pH 5 and 7 at population 50.0, with readable stacked cards and visible keyboard focus.

sweep-oxygen-phone-320.png.observation: At 320 pixels all five oxygen ticks fit. The selected 5/100 outline is visible near the left boundary and matches the 6.5 population readout; labels and stacked cards fit.

sweep-flat-square.png.observation: Every flat-response sample stays a square at population 5.0. The selected zero-oxygen square and guide are visible at the left boundary, and the readout states no modeled increase.
